r2DecisionGate.question: Do the same microwave functional diagnostic behaviors recur on Samsung ME11 — independent of LG component naming?

procedureObservations.title: §4-6: Door Interlock Switches
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Primary, monitor (COM-NC/NO), secondary, and door-sensing switches with continuity table — latch adjustment prevents oscillation.
procedureObservations.sequencing: Primary open/closed → monitor → secondary → door sensing; HV + vent cap discharge prerequisite.

measurements.logic: Primary ∞ door open / 0 closed; monitor NC behavior; door sensing for vent-only-on-plug-in

procedureObservations.title: §5-1: Dead Unit (No Display)
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Dead-unit tree through line power, magnetron TCO, interlock/monitor chain, then PCB.

procedureObservations.title: §5-1: No Heat (Timer Runs, No Oscillation)
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Latch alignment → magnetron TCO → power relay contacts → HV component path (§4-1–4-4).
procedureObservations.sequencing: Interlock before TCO before relay before HV cascade — same causal ordering as LG no-heat orchestration.
decisionLogic: Power relay contact continuity after START
Explicit HV path handoff when door/TCO/relay pass

procedureObservations.title: §4-1: High-Voltage Transformer
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Primary 0.41–0.48 Ω (variant-dependent); secondary ~123.5 or ~131 Ω ±2%; filament continuity.

procedureObservations.title: §4-3: High-Voltage Capacitor
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Charge then ~9 MΩ terminal-to-terminal; infinite terminal-to-chassis.

procedureObservations.title: §4-4: High-Voltage Diode
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: ∞ one direction; several hundred kΩ other direction (9V+ meter).

procedureObservations.title: §4-8: Thermal Cutouts (TCO)
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Four distinct TCO roles: cavity/flame 248°F non-reset; hood 158°F closes; bottom 248°F; magnetron 302°F resettable.
procedureObservations.sequencing: Independent TCO tests — broader than LG single TAB1–TAB2 cutout on no-heat path.

procedureObservations.title: C-20: Temperature Sensor Error
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Temp sensor fault — short indicated by black wire; routes before magnetron on coded no-heat paths.

procedureObservations.title: §4-14 / C-10: Humidity (Gas) Sensor
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Quick test 15–185 normal; ≥213 open; <6 short. Heater H terminals ~30 Ω.

procedureObservations.title: C-F0 / C-F1: PCB Communication
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Main ↔ sub PCB communication faults C-F0/C-F1 — distinct from touch-only failures.

procedureObservations.title: C-F2 / C-d0: Touch and Key Failure
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Touch film FPC and membrane short diagnostics.

procedureObservations.title: §4-7: Vent Exhaust Blower Motor
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Vent blower ~94 Ω across run-cap leads; discharge vent cap before test.

procedureObservations.title: §3-7: Turntable Drive Motor
procedureObservations.functionalBehavior: Operational/harness check → motor → PCB RY206 when rotation fails.
